title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments

analysis.tldr: SPADE stores generated environments and regret metadata across training episodes, then retrieves a few skill-matched examples into later Environment Designer prompts. A command-level no-memory run scores 53.2 versus 58.3 for the full package, but one run, suite-selected checkpoints, and unmatched demonstration tokens prevent attribution to regret retrieval, FIFO retention, or memory alone.
analysis.problem: A self-improving agent needs training environments near its current capability frontier. A stateless designer may repeatedly generate redundant, too-easy, or too-hard tasks instead of learning from earlier environment outcomes.
analysis.core_idea: Maintain a bounded environment buffer containing executable code, skill tags, win rate, regret, and rollout identity. Before generating a new environment, retrieve two skill-matched high-regret examples and one too-easy or too-hard negative; the generated environments then train the Reasoning Agent with GRPO.

memory_design.write: Accepted generated environments are appended with code, skill, win rate, regret, and rollout metadata.
memory_design.organize: A flat skill-tagged buffer is capped at 200 records and evicts the oldest record first.
memory_design.read: The Environment Designer receives up to two 2,000-character high-regret snippets plus one extreme negative descriptor for the same skill.
memory_design.update_forget: New environment outcomes append records and FIFO eviction bounds the buffer; the deployed Reasoning Agent does not use this memory at inference time.

compared_to: A NO_ENV_MEMORY command-level ablation that preserves the 30B launcher, corpus grounding, designer training, GRPO recipe, rollout count, and regeneration schedule
A no-corpus ablation and a fixed GPT-5.5 Environment Designer with memory
analysis.evidence: Across the eight reported game benchmarks, the selected full checkpoint averages 58.3 versus 53.2 without environment memory. The largest gaps are on Reasoning-Gym Math, Algorithmic, and Cognition, while AIME 2026 falls 75.0 to 74.4. Memory does not improve the reported diversity metric: Vendi/n is 0.68 full versus 0.69 without memory. The command ablation supports a package-level training-memory signal, not the specific regret/FIFO policy.
analysis.why_it_matters: Persistent agent state can guide the generation of future learning experiences even when the final actor has no inference-time memory. Training-side memory should therefore be evaluated separately from deployed memory and from the broader self-play package.
limitations: Each ablation is a single training run with no confidence interval or independent seed replication.
Every variant selects its best checkpoint on the same eight-benchmark suite used for the headline comparison.
Removing memory also removes several thousand characters of retrieved demonstrations; no token-matched static, random, or score-shuffled replay control is reported.
The released memory sampler is not passed an explicit seed, and public artifacts do not identify the exact no-memory run behind the table.
GPU-hours, generated tokens, wall time, dollars, energy, and validation-retry cost are unreported.
